name: prov_performance
description: Performance aspect of provenance: how to improve efficiency: the bottleneck, time per function and layer, I/O, parallelism, app- vs system-centric.

history.why: The user asked for the four aspects of provenance (traceability, accountability, decision making, performance), each its own capability, and for one reading capability (prov_read: TraceViewer) used by every graph, query and check.

User: "I want to add the perf annotation as a part of annotation sub capability for performance provenance it should add dftracer calls directly for performance apis." Stage 1 (skill only): describe perf_annotate, the planner of the `performance` spec section applied by prov_annotate. Code and checks follow by capability_refine.
